hypothesis_text: Preserve the full V29 estimator state and D21/K3 arithmetic; replace only dense bilinear matrix-product schedules by an exact trilinear-aggregation algorithm.

coefficient_table.format: sparse rational U/V/W coefficient matrices in NPZ
coefficient_table.coefficient_order_rule: Use CSR row order exactly as stored; no row reordering, coefficient refit, reduction, fusion, or post-result scheme selection.
coefficient_table.hash_policy: Git object identity freezes the external coefficient table pre-run. Any future vendored copy must additionally record SHA-256 in the owner manifest before an arm file exists.

base_case_and_blocking.input_padding: For A[m,k] and B[k,n], pad m,k,n independently upward to the next multiple of 32 with exact zeros.
base_case_and_blocking.partition: Partition each padded axis into exactly 32 equal contiguous blocks.
base_case_and_blocking.leaf_multiply: Use the frozen parent fnp.matmul for each rank-term block multiplication; no TA recursion and no alternative leaf algorithm.
base_case_and_blocking.reconstruction: Apply W coefficient rows in stored order; crop the padded output to original m x n.
base_case_and_blocking.dtype: Coefficient values are formed from stored rationals and cast once to the operation dtype (float64 for identity gate, float32 for production gate).

fallback.off_contract_fallback: Parent matmul is permitted only for n!=1024, depth!=16, or a non-frozen dtype; any such event in the authorized production-shape bundle is terminal COVERAGE_NO_GO.

coverage.routing_rule: Within every listed dense-K3 namespace, every bilinear matrix product routes to TA32; non-bilinear arithmetic in the namespace remains byte-for-byte parent arithmetic; whole-product parent fallback is forbidden for production-shape cases.
coverage.reconciliation_rule: Coverage pass uses the source GROUPED dense total 222.44u, not the sum of two-decimal family display rows. Any dense operation escaping the listed namespace rule is terminal.

exact_small_gate.fixture: Small integer/rational matrices with dimensions chosen as one 32x32 coefficient instance and one padded rectangular instance.
exact_small_gate.requirement: Bit-for-bit exact rational equality after TA reconstruction before any floating-point gate.

float32_gate.reference: Parent float64 output on byte-identical synthetic inputs.
float32_gate.control: Parent float32 output on byte-identical synthetic inputs.
float32_gate.candidate: TA32 float32 output on byte-identical synthetic inputs.
float32_gate.requirement: For every product family and for D3/D21, each TA32 float32 error metric versus parent-float64 must be <= 1.05 times the corresponding parent-float32 error metric. If the parent metric is exactly zero, the candidate metric must also be zero.

required: all zero padding/cropping charged when billed
flopscope_projection.parent_raw_count_precondition: Before any future arm, an exact raw flopscope parent integer ledger must be committed and must reconcile to the published 222.44u/260.06u rounding. This prerequisite is currently unmet.

runtime_projection.measurement_contract: Same process, one BLAS thread, same dtype, same synthetic inputs, same operation multiplicities; setup is included; replay timing is evidence-only and may not replace the first measurement.

immutable_manifest_contract.immutability: All evidence paths are append-only and content-addressed; no owner evidence file may be overwritten after first write.

verifier_may_use_only: immutable owner artifacts from the sole authorized workflow

forbidden_reads: leaderboard result data used for tuning

unresolved_blockers.reason: The published F86 log exposes headline/group/family values only at rounded unit precision and does not expose the exact raw flopscope integer count needed by E186 G2. Creating that count would require a new execution, forbidden in E187.

decision.rationale: At least one mandatory pre-run item cannot be frozen without execution; per E187 instructions no owner run may be armed.
